title: Stable population dynamics across days

titles: O’Doherty continuous random-target reaching:47sessions in two macaques

scientific_question: On the fixed Indy 2016-10-05 to 2016-10-06 development transfer, does a precommitted neural-history procedure predict next-bin electrode counts beyond source/calibration rate controls, and what is the descriptive gain from a declared lawful-history adaptation policy?
primary_outputs: Observed integer extracellular counts in the next 20 ms bin for all 96 M1 electrode channels; candidate outputs are strictly positive expected counts per bin. Evidence for adaptation is a held-out likelihood contrast, not agreement with a claim that dynamics are stable.

data_manifest.version: Zenodo record3854034, deposited2020-05-26; original dataset release2017, concept DOI10.5281/zenodo.788569
data_manifest.derivatives: NLB MC_RTT is a prepared subset of this source family; it must not be counted as an independent new cohort.

recording_contract.neural: Original MAT7.3 source stores chan_names and spikes as channel-by-unit cells, including an unsorted/hash unit; wf contains waveform snippets. Actual sampled header confirms chan_names[1,96], spikes[5,96],wf[5,96] reference arrays. Sorted units are not claimed longitudinally matched.
recording_contract.labels: cursor_pos and target_pos in millimeters; finger_pos in centimeters with coordinate order(z,-x,-y), optionally orientation; author metadata provides these units. Actual sampled file has cursor_pos[2,93501],finger_pos[3,93501],target_pos[2,93501].
recording_contract.time_alignment: Actual t[1,93501]header; author documents250Hz kinematic samples and spikes timestamped in seconds. NDT3 loader resamples finger position, derives velocity in m/s, bins spikes and handles sorted/hash unit aggregation; its configuration must be fixed before comparison.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Two named macaques Indy and Loco,37and10sessions respectively, identifiable from filenames. There are continuous self-paced reaches without experimenter-imposed trial gaps.
recording_contract.evidence: Original data-description schema and47-file manifest read; one83.96MB MAT file inspected through14,008bytes of HDF5 metadata, no numerical array values.

inputs: Count-only source training: 18,700 by 96 counts and 18,701 clock edges, preceding target day.
Count-only target-day first 60 s calibration: 3,000 by 96 counts and 3,001 clock edges; counts use uint32 and clock edges float64 in the documented export.
Sequential protocol request contains only previously committed/revealed count history; sequence 0 has no previous observation. Lawful-prefix online learning is allowed under the frozen procedure.
forbidden_inputs: Current or future target-bin counts before commitment; the NEURAL-023 public assessment packet or a union of task public directories.
Velocity, hand position, target position, evaluation labels/reference outputs or behavioral summaries.
Unrecorded prior exposure to the same source observations; later runtime isolation cannot erase earlier access.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Documented sequence IDs 0 through 22099 are mandatory; 0 through 9 are warm-up, 10 through 22099 map to target bins 3010 through 25099 and are scored. Each reply has all 96 strictly positive finite means. Protocol implementation is absent in this checkout, so IDs are specification facts rather than newly executed validation.
allowed_inputs.split: Historical first-day source counts, first 60 s of next-day calibration and subsequent sequential assessment, with the first 10 forecast rounds warm-up. A broader across-day test needs frozen chronological session pairs and session-specific readouts/electrode identities; no unit matching or movement-label adaptation may be assumed.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Historical finite scope covers every 22,090 scored bin and all 96 channels, with warm-up retained in protocol but excluded from all scores. This publication contains declarations for that scope; data/scorer/controller files named by delivery manifest are absent. Other sessions and Loco are not covered.

biological_unit: One monkey and one day pair; 2,120,640 scored channel-bin cells are dependent measurement outcomes, not biological replicates.
case_definition: One complete source-to-target day transfer episode: 22,100 required predict/reveal rounds, 10 warm-up rounds and 22,090 scored rounds with 96 outputs each.

reference.role: Official later NDT3 method implementation using the original O’Doherty data. It is not original acquisition-author code and not an independently qualified baseline. Original archive refh_results.csv is a historical result table, not executable decoder source.

controls: Enforce complete-vector durable commit before current-count reveal; an offline journal or candidate-authored attestation cannot prove causality.
Do not give NEURAL-023 packet access, repository-wide source observations or behavioral covariates to the candidate; disclose historical exposure in all results.
Use electrode-level aggregation consistently; sorted unit slots do not demonstrate cross-day identity.
Keep warm-up and all quiet/active bins fixed; no favorable-prefix selection, denominator changes or dropping low-rate channels.
Separate rate nonstationarity, self-history and cross-channel-history gains before interpreting population dynamics.

primary.name: bits_per_spike_vs_calibration_rate
primary.aggregation: Documented full Poisson log-likelihood difference between candidate and immutable calibration-rate reference, summed over all 2,120,640 scored channel-bin cells and divided by total observed spikes and ln(2). Exclude all 10 warm-up rounds; a zero spike denominator is undefined.
primary.rationale: Directly scores prediction of measured neural events beyond a stationary target-day rate; it does not score source-table reproduction or reward a preferred stability narrative.

secondary: Full Poisson log-likelihood including log-factorials and mean negative log-likelihood.
Per-channel descriptive results and all six signed immutable reference contrasts on identical support.
Calibration duration, allowed-history adaptation and preparation/inference cost; frozen-versus-adapted effects are descriptive until policy and compute are matched.

comparators.inputs: Source count history only or first 60 s target-day calibration counts.
comparators.procedure: Historical fixed stationary references declared in manifest; calibration_rate is the primary denominator/comparison. Recover exact source and numerical artifacts before execution.

comparators.procedure: Historical reference family isolates added population-history information. Keep channels, support and update exposures identical; exact scorer/reference implementations are missing from this source release.

evaluation.uncertainty: The delivered single pair supports a descriptive score and declared temporal-block sensitivity, not population inference. Resampling must preserve serial dependence and pair all methods on identical bins; bins/channels cannot be treated as independent monkeys. Additional chronological pairs should be summarized separately for Indy and Loco.
evaluation.failure_policy: Documented protocol requires complete ordered handshake, all 22,100 nonce-bound replies, all 96 positive finite means and stop acknowledgment. Missing/duplicate/out-of-order replies, partial prefixes and invalid numbers receive no scientific score. Zero denominator stays undefined and finite arithmetic failure is reported, not clipped. Current publication lacks the parser/grader required to enforce this policy.

holds.requirement: Resolve unit mapping or use session-specific readouts; do not infer animal population effects from two monkeys.

Only two biological subjects;47sessions do not support a47-animal generalization claim. No scientific baseline or model score has been reproduced.
